newsitem.title: FRANCE: Saudis buy barley at maximum $161/tonne -traders.
newsitem.headline: Saudis buy barley at maximum $161/tonne -traders.

text.p: Saudi Arabia has bought 1.2 million tonnes of optional-origin barley at a maximum price of $161 per tonne, cost and freight, European traders said on Wednesday.
The barley is for February and March delivery.
Saudi Arabia tendered on Tuesday for 1.2 million tonnes of optional-origin feed barley with 500,000 tonnes to be delivered by the end of February and 700,000 tonnes by March 30.

The European Union expects to meet the bulk of the sale, followed by Australia and Canada. But traders said the maximum price of $161 per tonne already pointed to another tussle between the trade and the European Commission over refunds.
Earlieron Wednesday Commission sources hinted they would consider bids over $140 per tonne fob but traders said this would be tight for most shippers. Freight is about $20 a tonne.
